messages:
Maya (PM): quick thought — pushing a small change to the first-run flow: show 3 onboarding presets instead of 6. want quick feedback on tradeoffs.
Liam (Design): agree on fewer cards. 6 feels noisy on 1200px width; users bounce. can we prioritize fewer choices + a compact 'more options' link?
Samira (DevEx): +1 for progressive disclosure. concern: users who want specific infra (dedicated/private) might not find it. how do we surface that?
Jonah (Eng): technically trivial to hide extras and surface via a link. main work is updating telemetry so we know which preset was chosen.
Maya (PM): telemetry is important — add an event for preset_chosen + onboarding_path. also, prefer labels that are action-oriented not infra-first. e.g., 'Start fast (hosted)' vs 'Hosted'.
Liam (Design): mockup attached (link): presets use short benefit copy under title: 2 lines max. button primary label: 'Try preset' feels weak. suggestions: 'Get started', 'Use preset', or 'Start with this'.
Claire (A11y): accessibility nits: contrast on the preset card border is < 3:1 in low-power mode. keyboard focus outline is missing on the card as a whole — only on the button. screen reader should announce expanded details.
Samira (DevEx): can we add a small inline example of what a preset does? e.g., snippet: `Preset: Minimal -> Model: small-2, Batch: 8, KV cache: on` helps set expectations.
Jonah (Eng): that snippet is fine. if we show config blurbs, keep them collapsed by default. also, if someone chooses preset, we should pre-populate the setup checklist.
Maya (PM): question for design: compact preset card vs guided rail (vertical stepper on right). which is less intimidating for new users?
Liam (Design): compact cards are better for discovery, rail is better for conversion. Maybe AB test: variant A = 3 cards + 'more' modal, variant B = single highlighted card + right rail that walks you through one quick step at a time.
Claire (A11y): on the rail option make sure stepper buttons are reachable via single tab sequence and have `aria-current` for step context. sample aria: `aria-current="step"` on active step.
Samira (DevEx): copy tweak: the hero CTA currently says 'Create project' but contextually they just get a workspace with sample app. 'Create workspace' or 'Start workspace' may be clearer.
Liam (Design): agreed. also microcopy under CTA: 'Includes sample prompts and metrics' — feels vague. change to 'Includes sample app, prompts, and a cost estimate.'
Jonah (Eng): small implementation note: analytics wants preset_id and variant_id for AB test. we'll set variant_id to 'cards' or 'rail'. Prefill logic will be `POST /onboard/prefill` with payload `{preset_id, user_id, variant_id}`.
Maya (PM): tagging: @Claire please run quick a11y checklist on both mocks. @Jonah can you add telemetry events? @Liam can you produce the AB mockups for engineering?
Claire (A11y): I'll run quick checks and push a checklist comment. quick items: focus order, contrast, screen reader headings, and `role="list"` semantics for preset list.
Samira (DevEx): one more UX ask — add a tiny 'Why choose this?' tooltip on each preset with one-sentence tradeoffs. keeps main card clean but provides context.
Liam (Design): love the tooltip idea. will design with a 2-line limit and 14px type. will also include a small link 'Customize' that opens the advanced modal.
Maya (PM): timeline — aim for a small release behind a feature flag next week so we can start the AB test. I'll follow up with rollout plan. :rocket:
SetupBot: deploy-preview for `feat/onboard-presets` is ready at https://preview.redwood-inference/test-onboard-2087 :white_check_mark:
Jonah (Eng): noted — I'll wire the events and add the prefills. ping me if the mock includes new metadata fields.
Maya (PM): cool. thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for any last-minute accessibility or copy nits.
